Interaktive Erlebnisausstellung Dem Fluss auf der Spur zum letzten Wildfluss der Nordalpen

kurzbeschreibung: The Naturparkhaus on the Klimmbrücke in Elmen hovers directly above the Lech and showcases the last wild river of the Northern Alps.
beschreibung:
Floating Visitor Center Above the Wild River

The Naturparkhaus Klimmbrücke in Elmen forms the architectural and ecological centerpiece of the Naturpark Tiroler Lech. Perched like a bold sculpture right above the river bed, the building brings the untamed dynamics of this unique river landscape to life.

Unique Biodiversity and River Dynamics

In the interactive exhibition Dem Fluss auf der Spur, visitors discover the rare species inhabiting the vast gravel banks, including the common sandpiper and the German tamarisk. The center serves as the perfect gateway to memorable nature hikes along the Lech.
